fields.description: Yas Riva is Aldar’s original 151-villa community on northern Yas Island, launched in 2024. It offers four and five-bedroom inland villas and five and six-bedroom canal villas, with distinct designs for the waterfront and garden settings.

research.community: Original Yas Riva villas · Yas Island
overview: The canal-front homes were announced with private docks; inland villas instead reach the water through community walkways. These are different waterfront relationships, so a private mooring should not be assumed for every home.

Interiors were developed with 1058 London. The reviewed layouts show separate formal and family spaces, service rooms and lift provision. Optional outdoor pods can serve different uses, and pool arrangements depend on the selected home and purchase specification.
research.locationNote: On the northern shores of Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. This record covers the original Yas Riva villas, not the later Yas Riva Reserve launch or the separate Yas Riva Residences apartment scheme.
research.priceNote: The fact sheet and PSI give AED 8.3m at launch. Current stock, prices and optional additions require a fresh quotation.
research.paymentNote: Original 50/50 instalment dates vary by phase. Obtain an updated statement before relying on this historic schedule.
research.handoverNote: The fact sheet gives Q3 2028, the original phase payment table names 11 March 2028, and PSI reports Q2 2028. The 2028 year is consistent, but the applicable phase date is not resolved; obtain the latest developer notice for the chosen villa.

facts.label: Optional outdoor space
facts.value: The fact sheet illustrates a 32 sq m multipurpose pod and a pool option for inland and canal villas. Inclusion, choice and additional cost must be confirmed in the selected specification.
